ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Εκτεταµένο ύδραρθρο παρατηρείται στην άρθρωση του γόνατος. Ο έσω µηνίσκος παρουσιάζει εκφύλιση grade II χωρίς ρήξη. Ο έξω µηνίσκος έχει δισκοειδή µορφολογία, εκφύλιση στο σώµα και πιθανότατα ρήξη Bucket handle µε ήπια µετατόπιση προς την µεσοκονδύλια εντοµή. Ο αρθρικός χόνδρος έχει ικανοποιητική απεικόνιση. ∆ιατατική κάκωση του ιγνυακού µυός (strain grade I ). Μερική ρήξη παρατηρείται στον πρόσθιο χιαστό σύνδεσµο. Ο οπίσθιος χιαστός και οι πλάγιοι σύνδεσµοι απεικονίζονται φυσιολογικοί. Οστικός µώλωπας µικρής έκτασης παρατηρείται στην οπίσθια έξω κνηµιαία επίφυση. Παρεµπιπτόντως παρατηρούνται κιρσοειδείς διευρύνσεις φλεβών κατά την οπίσθια µοίρα του γόνατος.

Απο τον έλεγχο του έξω µηνίσκου, των χιαστών των πλαγίων συνδέσµων, του αρθρικού χόνδρου, του οστικού µυελού και του εκτατικού µηχανισµού δεν παρατηρούνται παθολογικά ευρήµατα. MRI : ΑΡΙΣΤΕΡΟ ΓΟΝΑΤΟ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ: Η εξέταση έγινε µε ακολουθίες παλµών Τ1 και πυκνότητας πρωτονίων µε καταστολή του σήµατος του λίπους σε τοµογράφο 3 Τesla. [DATE]. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ: Επανελέγχεται χωρίς ουσιώδη διαφοροποίηση η εκφύλιση του έσω µηνίσκου και το υπερξάρθρηµα χωρίς ευρήµατα ρήξης. Από τον έλεγχο του έξω µηνίσκου, του οπίσθιου χιαστού και των πλαγίων συνδέσµων δεν παρατηρούνται παθολογικά ευρήµατα.   Από τον έλεγχο του προσθίου χιαστού συνδέσµου παρατηρείται µυξοειδής εκφύλιση και παρουσία µικρών γαγγλιακών κύστεων στη µοιριαία πρόσφυση αυτού. Τα ευρήµατα δεν προϋπήρχαν. Μικρή γαγγλιακή κύστη 6 mm παρατηρείται προσθίως την κνηµιαίας κατάφυσης του προσθίου χιαστού συνδέσµου. Μικρή συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδαρθρικά.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia izquierda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco medial es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Pequeña rotura radial incompleta de la unión del cuerno anterior, cuerpo del menisco lateral.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones
significativas. Condropatía rotuliana superficial de predomino la faceta medial.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral sugiriendo fenómenos
de fricción regional. No hay alteraciones en la grasa de Hoffa.
Ligamento patelofemoral medial sin alteraciones.
Impresión:
Condropatía rotuliana superficial.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica.

- The study reveals evidence of lateral part of right fibular head fracture with the bony fragment dislocated, measuring about 1.3 cm from the fracture site and measured in size about 1.2xintact9xintact9 cm in APxWtxHt dimensions. This fracture fragment is seen attaching to the arcuate ligament without evidence of disruption of the arcuate ligament. Overall findings are suggestive for avulsion fracture of the right fibular. head. 
 - There is associated mild high SI along distal part of lateral collateral ligament, distal part of biceps femoris tendon and also at the conjoined tendon at the fibular attachment; suggested strain. 
 - High marrow SI at anterior aspect of proximal tibia and posterior aspect of medial femoral condyle is demonstrated; suggested bone contusion. 
  
 Central supporting system  
 - Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Abnormal orientation with high grade partial thickness tear at distal part of ACL with high SI along entire ACL. The tear is located about 6 mm above the medial eminence.  
 - Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): High grade partial thickness tear at mid to distal part of PCL is shown. No evidence of avulsion at tibial attachment site. 
 - Anterior tibial translation: None.  
  
 Medial compartment  
 - Medial meniscus: High SI at meniscofemoral and meniscotibial region; suggested meniscocapsular injury. 
 - Medial collateral ligament: High SI at deep band of medial collateral ligament; suggested strain. 
 - Medial tibial plateau, medial femoral condyle: Preserved chondral cartilage. 
  
 Lateral compartment  
 - Lateral meniscus: Several tears as described; 
 -- Horizontal high SI along anterior horn of lateral meniscus; suggested horizontal tear. 
 -- Vertical high SI at anterior horn of lateral meniscus; suggested combined vertical tear. 
 -- Radial tear at posterior horn of lateral meniscus with involvement of the posterior root. 
 - Iliotibial band: Normal.  
 - Lateral collateral ligament and biceps femoris tendon: Mild high SI along distal part of lateral collateral ligament, distal part of biceps femoris tendon and also at the conjoined tendon at the fibular attachment; suggested strain. 
 - Popliteus tendon: Poorly identified course of the popliteus tendon with high SI at the myotendinous junction; suggested partial tear of the popliteus tendon. Intermediate SI of the popliteus muscle is shown; suggested muscle strain. 
 - Popliteofibular ligament: Preserved, normal alignment.  
 - Lateral tibial plateau, lateral femoral condyle: Preserved chondral cartilage. 
  
 Patellofemoral compartment  
 - Focal bone marrow edema at the inferior part of the patella bone. 
 - Quadriceps tendon: Normal.  
 - Patellar ligament: Normal.  
 - Medial patellar retinaculum: High SI with some part thinning at the attachment to medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL); suggested medial patellar retinaculum strain with partial tear of MPFL. 
 - Lateral patellar retinaculum: Normal.  
 - Moderate amount of hyperintense SI fluid causing distension of the suprapatellar bursa. Mild thickening of the synovial tissue is noted. 
 - Moderate fat stranding at the suprapatellar fossa is shown. 
 - Normal articular cartilage of patellar facet and femoral troclear is observed.  
  
 Others  
 - Subcutaneous edema extending from prepatellar to tibial tuberosity region. 
 - Subcutaneous contusion along posteromedial, anteromedial, posterolateral and anterolateral aspect of subcutaneous layer is shown. 
 - Superficial fluid along fascia is seen. 
 - Hyper SI at distal part of tibialis posterior, vastus intermedius and vastus medialis muscle are seen; suggested muscle strain. 
 - A fat globule anterior to the proximal tibia is shown. 
 - Visualized neurovascular bundles show intraluminal eccentric loss of flow void at the popliteal vein with dilatation distally; suggested deep venous thrombosis. The popliteal artery is grossly preserved. - Avulsion fracture of lateral part of right fibular head with associated strain of lateral collateral ligament and bicpes femoris tendon. 
 - Partial tear of popliteus tendon. 
 - Horizontal and vertical tear at anterior horn of lateral meniscus. Radial tear at posterior horn with posterior root tear of lateral meniscus. 
 - Meniscofemoral and meniscotibial tear. 
 - Medial patellar retinaculum strain with partial tear of MPFL. 
 - High grade partial thickness tear at distal part of ACL. 
 - High grade partial thickness tear at mid to distal part of PCL. 
 - Bone contusion at anterior aspect of proximal tibia and posterior aspect of medial femoral condyle with soft tissue contusion at posteromedial, anteromedial, posterolateral and anterolateral aspect of knee joint. 
 - Deep venous thrombosis at right popliteal vein.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: osteoarthritis
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 3.0 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Degeneration involving the posterior horn/body of the medial meniscus without discrete tear by MR criteria.

Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Mildly edematous.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Mildly edematous.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is a lateral patellar translation.. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology.  

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
There is a minimal edema noted anterior to the patellar tendon. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Mildly edematous medial patellar retinaculum, nonspecific and can be seen with mild sprain.
2. Degeneration of the medial meniscus without obvious tear.
3. Minimally edematous MCL, could be related to grade 1 sprain.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar ön çapraz bağdaki mukoid dejenerasyon dışında normal. Medyal menisküs gövdesi düzeyindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışı yırtık biçiminde eklem yüzeylerine ulaşmıyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Lateral knee pain.
Comparison: Right knee radiograph [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Small leaking Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear involving the body, posterior horn and posterior root, noting a complete radial tear at the posterior root. Moderate meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade articular cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint with areas of full-thickness cartilage loss/fissuring and associated subchondral signal changes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint in the lateral joint line.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade articular cartilage loss throughout the patella with areas of full-thickness loss at the median ridge and medial facet with associated subchondral signal changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon. Stripping of the prepatellar quadriceps continuation. Prepatellar bursitis.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 12 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Complex tearing of the medial meniscus body, posterior horn and posterior root. Dominant complete radial component at the posterior root. Moderate meniscal extrusion.
2.	Mild-to-moderate tricompartmental osteoarthritis. Moderate knee joint effusion.
3.	Small leaking Baker's cyst.
4.	Prepatellar bursitis.

Central supporting system  
  Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Chronic tear of mid to proximal part of ACL, residual portion at distal part. 
  Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Bucking of PCL without abnormal SI.  
  Anterior tibial translation is noted, measured about 1.0 cm.  
  
 Medial compartment  
  Medial meniscus: Horizontal and longitudinal tear involving body to posterior root. Radial tear involving body part. 
  Medial collateral ligament: high SI with partial disruption of medial ligament, predominately at deep MCL; MCL sprain grade II.  
  Medial tibial plateau: No marrow edema or fracture line.Thinning of articular cartilage. 
  Medial femoral condyle: No marrow edema or fracture line. Thinning of articular cartilage.  
  
 Lateral compartment  
  Lateral meniscus: Intact. 
  Iliotibial band: Intact.  
  Lateral collateral ligament: Intact 
  Popliteus tendon: Intact.  
  Popliteofibular ligament: Intact.  
  Biceps femoris tendon : Intact.  
  Lateral tibial plateau: No marrow edema or fracture line. Intact articular surface.  
  Lateral femoral condyle: No marrow edema or fracture line. Intact articular surface.  
  
 Patellofemoral compartment  
  Quadriceps tendon: Intact.  
  Patellar tendon: Intact.  
  Medial patellar retinaculum: Intact.  
  Lateral patellar retinaculum: Intact.  
  
 Others  
  Right joint effusion extended to supra patellar bursa with fibrinous thickening; suggested synovitis with bursitis 
  Minimal stranding of inferior patella fat pad; mild inflammation.  
  Muscle: Unremarkable.  
  Neurovascular bundles: Intact.  Chronic tear of ACL with MCL sprain (grade II) and meniscus tear as described; compatible with terrible triad (O'Donoghue unhappy triad)
